name: shva
description: Shiva Kakkar's personal Claude Code plugins. Cross-cutting tools that aren't tied to any single product — vocabulary briefings, prompt scaffolds, LinkedIn authoring with Shiva's voice, and personal workflow accelerators.

plugins.name: shva
plugins.description: Personal command + skill pack. v0.1.0 shipped /shva:brief-me — a domain-agnostic pre-project vocabulary briefing that returns a 20-25 term glossary (Creative/Style · Technical/Process · Prompt/Direction) before any GenAI build (code, design, video, music, art); forces vocabulary alignment between user and AI before instructions are given, reducing drift and hallucination; ships with the 'flag terms I'm using incorrectly' coda that turns Claude into a real-time vocabulary coach. v0.3.0 adds /shva:shva-linkedin-post-writer — write LinkedIn posts in Dr. Shiva Kakkar's distinctive systems-thinker voice using three signature lenses (Sequence Inversion, Constraint Migration, Authority Redesign), six-tier MCP source hierarchy (his Readwise/Voicenotes/Plaud/Gemini-files/LlamaCloud first, web as support last), Hook Test + Cringe Test gates, kostja mechanics clash table, and a god-mode pipeline that handles post + visual + LinkedIn publish protocol + self-learning JSONL loop + Wiki Save + Taste Capture into the Obsidian LLM wiki. v0.4.0 adds the Medium duo: /shva:shva-medium-writer drafts a 1500-2000 word Medium-grade essay in Shiva's voice for shivakakkar.com (7-beat long-form template, Astro frontmatter, SEO/AI-SEO co-citation rules — ≥3 tier-1 institutional names co-located with Rehearsal/Gradeless, ≥5 quotable standalone sentences, v1.0 bio footer); /shva:shva-medium-poster publishes the deployed essay to Medium under 'Built at Rehearsal' via Chrome automation (state machine over import → cleanup → tags → submit-for-review, cache-staleness sentinel detection, full failure-recovery playbook from the 4-essay 2026-05-12 session). v0.5.0 promotes the LinkedIn anti-staccato cadence rule and the explicit LinkedIn MCP confirmation step. v0.6.0 adds /shva:worksheet-generator, which turns a topic plus rough ideas into an AI-resistant, self-contained, print-ready teaching worksheet (HTML first for review, then a ReportLab PDF) in Shiva's voice. It runs a 7-stage pipeline: AskUserQuestion intake, parallel deep research across LlamaCloud, the Obsidian wiki, Readwise, YouTube, book-search, and Mobbin design taste, a carried-forward content arc with one worked example threaded through, the hard formatting rules (no author names, no em or en dashes, plain language, proportional boxes, contextual Be Mindful panels, real signing space), an HTML house-style template with a render-and-eyeball verify loop, and a ReportLab print build. It bundles the aesthetic-pdf-creator guide, the worked DHRL builder, the HTML template, a banned-string lint, and a render-check script.
